notes.title: V 1.03.09
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This new minor update focuses on improving the user interface:

Almost all windows can now be closed by clicking outside or using the Escape key.
Almost all windows can now be closed or opened with a keyboard shortcut.
A windowed mode has been added, available via options.
Other minor additions and fixes

If you want to load a former save, you'll have to go back to the old version.

Please report any bugs or issues.

notes.title: USA and Science fiction
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The new game in the franchise, 'Vox Populi: USA 2024' is now available! Take on the role of one of the candidates in this year's US presidential election, or start one of the seven other fictional scenarios available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061790/Vox_Populi_USA_2024

Here's a non-exhaustive list of what's new from this version:

Unique events linked to real events in the country
A new voting system: the Electoral College, with new Winner-take-all strategies
New referendums allowing total victory in the Red Wave and Monarchist Wave scenarios
But most importantly: Science fiction scenarios with their own ideologies, corpuses, character traits, events and regions. You can play as an alien, an advocate of equality between species, or the opposite, of the domination of one species over another.
If you wish, our new Discord server has just been updated so we can communicate: https://discord.com/invite/N8E5Yc72Ym


See you soon!

notes.title: Cards and debates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The new major update 'Cards and Debates' is now online and brings several new features to 'Vox Populi: Europa 2024':
 Completely revamped deckbuilding: the cards in your campaign team can now be purchased with a new resource: Rhetoric Points. This means you'll be able to choose the type and quality of your deck more easily.
 An encyclopaedia of cards and debate effects, accessible from a running game.
 Two new achievements to accompany this new feature: 'Advanced Rhetoric' and 'Master of the Playing Cards'.
 Minor graphical tweaks to debates
Other important changes in this update include:
 The German version is now available.
 A flag gallery accessible from the main menu
 The AI can now propose referendums during the game.
 When the player wins, a classic speech animation and new music will appear.
 It is now possible to choose simplified explanations for certain aspects of the tutorial.
 Game tips, which can be turned off, will appear during the game if the player makes a strategic mistake.
 The existing characters panel will no longer causes lags.
 Streaming mode now has its own music.
 Numerous minor improvements and bug fixes
Please report any bugs or issues. The link to the new discord (https://discord.com/invite/N8E5Yc72Ym) has been fixed, so you're all welcome there too.

Finally, the 'Vox Populi: USA 2024' game with its many original features (including several science fiction scenarios), is coming very soon. If you're interested, add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061790/Vox_Populi_USA_2024

notes.title: Small Update - 1.03.06
notes.content:
Hello, here's the list of changes for this small update:

 The "sociology" notion has been changed to "demographic group" in English, Spanish and Polish.
 The German version is now available as a beta test. If you want to test it, join our Discord to get the password. (https://discord.gg/AWdvAe4m)
 Some minor corrections

notes.title: Small update - 1.03.05.b
notes.content:
Hello ! Here's the list of the main changes for this update:

Steam successes are now implemented.
The bug that caused debates to stop has now been fixed.
The AI will get less good cards in the middle and end of the game.
Some national flags have been corrected. More changes to come.

notes.title: Vox Populi: Europa 2024 - Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The political strategy game 'Vox Populi: Europa 2024' is now released!

Here's a reminder of the main features that differ from the other games in the series:
A new mechanism of laws and referendums to be organised during the campaign
Seven scenarios, including the 2024 European Union elections and many other futuristic fictional scenarios
Unique combinations of ideologies and Corpus, linked to dozens of new European and national flags.
A new system of political paths specific to Europe, allowing players to navigate between Europeanism, Socialism and Sovereignism

A new Discord where we can communicate directly with each other has also just opened: https://discord.gg/NTP48dJR

The game is available in English, French, Spanish and Polish. German and Italian versions will be available soon.

See you soon!
